segments.text: Over a thousand retail traders discovered their foreign portfolios were sold off without consent.

segments.text: So how does an Indian investing app suddenly sell your US shares?
segments.broll: aerial view modern high rise glass building cityscape daylight

segments.text: Most Indian fintech apps don't hold US shares directly. They route orders through foreign partner brokers.
segments.broll: slow motion hands typing on laptop keyboard glowing
broll_alt: close up server room lights blinking
hands using digital tablet in dark room

segments.text: If that overseas partner faces liquidity trouble or margin calls, automated risk algorithms can liquidate client stocks.
segments.broll: dramatic red stock market ticker screen scrolling close up
broll_alt: digital stock chart plummeting red lines
financial data numbers screen red glow

segments.text: Always verify custodian transparency and regulatory rules before using international investment platforms.
